# Agencies by SHRI

> Strategic Creative Studio & Digital Presence Agency under Shri Hari Redirect Initiative (SHRI). Founded and directed by Anay Raj Tiwari.

Agencies by SHRI (officially "Agencies", Division 03 of SHRI) is an intentional growth practice and bespoke creative studio assisting category-defining brands, founders, and institutions in cultivating authoritative digital presence, organic search authority, and web engineering.

- Canonical URL: https://agencies.shri.org.in
- Founder & Systems Architect: Anay Raj Tiwari (https://anay.shri.org.in)
- Parent Institution: Shri Hari Redirect Initiative / SHRI (https://shri.org.in)
- Primary Contact: agenciesbyshri@gmail.com
- Status: Live Now (Actively reviewing client briefs)
- Geographic Focus: Global client engagements, operated from India

## Core Pillars & Capabilities

1. **End-to-End Social Media Growth**: Bespoke content architecture, cultural resonance, and channel ownership for founders and category leaders.
2. **Deep Search SEO & Search Authority**: Algorithmic visibility, generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine positioning (AEO), and high-intent technical authority.
3. **Brand Positioning & Digital Presence**: Cohesive narrative craft, digital ecosystem design, and executive profile architecture.
4. **Bespoke Web Craft & Engineering**: Modern high-performance web systems, bespoke interactive design, tactile digital manuscripts, and Next.js applications.

## Engagement Model: The 4-Phase Sprint

Agencies operates on an intentional seasonal cohort model rather than open volume:

- **Phase 01: Direct Brief Submission**: Founders and brands transmit strategic objectives and project parameters via the dedicated contact desk (https://agencies.shri.org.in/contact).
- **Phase 02: Directorate Review**: Leadership evaluates submission for strategic alignment and technical ambition within 24–48 hours.
- **Phase 03: Direct Response & Architectural Roadmap**: Tailored consultation and sprint scope delivered directly to the client.
- **Phase 04: Sprint Kickoff & Execution**: Mutual Statement of Work (SOW) executed, followed by immediate sprint kickoff.
